scripts.text:
[Maia]
Best of luck in your
journeys. As you master
more Soul Linker skills,
you will be able to draw
more of the spirits' power
to endow upon your allies...
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
愿你在旅途中好运。
随着你掌握更多的悟灵士技能，
你将能汲取更多精灵的力量，
并将其赋予你的同伴...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Aren't you a warrior
of the sun? I'm familiar
with your ways. After all,
the basis of both of our
skills is grounded in the
Taekwon Do job, right?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你难道不是太阳的战士吗？
我很熟悉你的路数。
毕竟，我们两人的技能基础
都源于跆拳职业，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Aren't you a warrior of
the moon? I'm familiar
with your ways. After all,
the basis of both of our
skills is grounded in the
Taekwon Do job, right?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你难道不是月亮的战士吗？
我很熟悉你的路数。
毕竟，我们两人的技能基础
都源于跆拳职业，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Mm? I've got nothing to
offer you. But if you know
any well experienced
practitioners of Taekwon
Do, they might benefit
from what I know.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯？我没什么能给你的。
但如果你认识任何经验丰富的
跆拳修行者，
我所学的东西或许对他们有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
So you're studying
Taekwon Do. That's good,
that's very good. Just keep
refining those skills and
stick to your training.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
原来你在修习跆拳。
很好，非常好。
继续磨练那些技能，
坚持你的训练吧。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
...
Hey you.

[{0}]
Did you call me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在叫我吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Yeah, I called you.
Now don't make me
raise my voice, and
just get over here.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
对，我在叫你。
别逼我提高嗓门，
快过来。

scripts.text: You're awfully rude for a kid!
scripts.translation: 你这小孩真没礼貌！

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Kid]
You're lucky I'm
taking an interest
in you! I might look
like a kid, but I'm over
three hundred years old!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你运气真好，我居然对你感兴趣！
我虽然看起来像个小孩，
但我已经三百多岁了！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Now listen...
I know that you're a
disciple of Taekwon Do.
It's a respectable art, but
I've got a proposition for
you if you want to hear it.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
听好了...
我知道你是跆拳的弟子。
这是一门受人尊敬的技艺，
但我有个提议，如果你愿意听的话。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I'm looking at you, and I can
already tell that you're very
spiritually inclined. You've
got a lot of potential I don't
wanna see wasted. Why don't
you become a ''Soul-Linker?''
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我看着你，就已经能看出
你很有灵性。你有很大的潜力，
我不想看到它被浪费。
何不成为一名“悟灵士”呢？

scripts.text: Ha! Silly little boy~
scripts.translation: 哈！傻小子~

scripts.text: Soul Linker?
scripts.translation: 悟灵士？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
You... You d-don't
believe me? I'm being
dead serious. Can you
forget the fact that I look
like a little kid for just one
minute? *Psh* ...Youngsters.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你...你难道不...不相信我？
我是认真的。你能不能
哪怕一分钟，别把我当成
一个小孩子看？*啧*...年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Soul Linkers communicate
with spirits of fallen warriors
that still wish to fight in the
world of the living. Now, these
warrior spirits can't fight as
themselves in our world.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
悟灵士与那些仍渴望在
生者世界战斗的陨落战士
的精灵沟通。不过，这些
战士精灵无法以他们自己的
形态在我们的世界战斗。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
However, since you're
spiritually inclined, these
spirits are attracted to you.
With enough training, you can
temporarily imbue the power of these spirits to your allies.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
然而，由于你很有灵性，
这些精灵会被你吸引。
经过足够的训练，你可以
暂时将这些精灵的力量赋予你的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Now, you can't imbue yourself
with the spirits' power. Also,
depending on your skills as
a Soul Linker, you can only
endow other characters of certain job classes with enchanced power.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
不过，你不能将精灵的力量
赋予你自己。此外，取决于你
作为悟灵士的技能，你只能
为特定职业的角色赋予增强力量。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
You'll have to enter
a wholly different world
to become a Soul Linker,
but I know it'll be possible
for you. So what do you say?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
要成为悟灵士，你必须
进入一个完全不同的世界，
但我知道对你来说这是可能的。
那么，你怎么说？

scripts.text: No. At least, not now...
scripts.translation: 不。至少，现在还不...

scripts.text: Alright. What do I have to do?
scripts.translation: 好的。我需要做什么？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Ah, alright. Well,
if you ever decide to
become a Soul Linker,
then please come back
and talk to me at any time.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
啊，好的。那么，
如果你决定要成为悟灵士，
请随时回来找我谈话。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
So you want to become
a Soul Linker? Great!
Alright, first I need you
to bring back a few items.
Don't worry, I'll explain
why you need them later.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你想成为悟灵士？太好了！
首先，我需要你带回几样物品。
别担心，之后我会解释为什么需要它们。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Now bring me
^0000FF1 3 Carat Diamond^000000,
^0000FF1 Immortal Heart^000000 and
^0000FF1 Witherless Rose^000000.
And try not to make me
wait too long, alright?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
现在，请给我
^0000FF1 3克拉钻石^000000、
^0000FF1 不死心脏^000000 和
^0000FF1 永恒玫瑰^000000。
别让我等太久，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Huh...?
Wait, where are
you going? I'm...
I'm talking to you!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯...？
等等，你要去哪？我...我还在跟你说话呢！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
You're back, eh?
So did you bring
^0000FF1 3 Carat Diamond^000000,
^0000FF1 Immortal Heart^000000 and
^0000FF1 Witherless Rose^000000.
like I asked you to?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你回来了？
所以，你带回了
^0000FF1 3克拉钻石^000000、
^0000FF1 不死心脏^000000 和
^0000FF1 永恒玫瑰^000000
吗，就像我要求的那样？

scripts.text: There you are.
scripts.translation: 给你。

scripts.text: No, not yet...
scripts.translation: 不，还没...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Great, I see that you've
brought everything. But
before we begin, let me
introduce myself. My name
is Maia, and I've been alive for more than three hundred years.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
很好，看来你带齐了所有东西。
但在开始之前，让我自我介绍一下。
我叫玛雅，已经活了三百多年了。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Without giving away too many
of the details, I've been divinely charged with the duty of finding
and recruiting more Soul Linkers. That's part of the reason why
I haven't, you know, passed on.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
不透露太多细节的话，
我受神谕之命，负责寻找并招募更多的悟灵士。
这也是我之所以没有...离开的部分原因。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Anyway, I still need to finish
preparations with the materials
that you just brought, so would
you come back in a little bit?
Then, we'll talk once again.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
总之，我还需要用你刚带来的材料完成准备工作，
请稍等片刻再回来好吗？
到时候，我们再好好谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Mm...?
Hey. You forgot
a few things. Now
go back and bring
everything that I ask
for this time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯...？
嘿。你忘了几样东西。
现在回去，把这次要求的所有东西都带回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I know I just told you
what we need, but I'm
going to remind you again:
^0000FF1 3 Carat Diamond^000000,
^0000FF1 Immortal Heart^000000 and
^0000FF1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我知道我刚告诉过你需要什么，
但我再提醒你一次：
^0000FF1 3克拉钻石^000000、
^0000FF1 不死心脏^000000 和
^0000FF1 永恒玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Mm. That's fine.
Although I have all
the time to spare in
the world, I don't like
to wait for very long.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯。没关系。
虽然我拥有无尽的时间，
但我并不喜欢等待太久。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
You've become a warrior
of the Sun, the Moon and
the Stars instead? I had no
idea you had that potential.
I suppose I can't blame you...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你反而成为了太阳、月亮和星星的战士？
我没想到你有那样的潜力。
我想我也不能责怪你...

scripts.text:
[Maia]
You still have some
unallocated Skill Points.
Use them all to learn some
Taekwon Do skills, and then
return when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
你还有未分配的技能点。
把它们全部用来学习跆拳技能，
然后准备好后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Right now, someone else
is completing the ceremony
to become a Soul Linker.
Would you please wait until
it's finished? Then, when I'm
available, I'll attend to you.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
现在，有其他人正在完成成为悟灵士的仪式。
请等到仪式结束好吗？
然后，当我有空时，我会为你服务。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Great, I've finished
the preparations. Now
we'll proceed with the
ceremony to change
you into a Soul Linker.
Now close your eyes...
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
很好，准备工作已完成。
现在我们将进行仪式，
将你转变为悟灵士。
现在闭上眼睛...

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Are you ready to
enter the depths
of your mind again?
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
你准备好再次进入
你心灵的深处了吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Well then, come
back to me when you
think you are ready.
Until then, I'll be
waiting right here.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
那么，当你觉得自己准备好的时候，
再回来找我吧。
在那之前，我会一直在这里等待。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Right now, someone else
is completing the ceremony
to become a Soul Linker.
Would you please wait until
it's finished? Then, when I'm
available, I'll attend to you.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
现在，有其他人正在完成成为悟灵士的仪式。
请等到仪式结束好吗？
然后，当我有空时，我会为你服务。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Alright then, close
your eyes and relax.
We'll go back into the
depths of your mind.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
好的，闭上眼睛，放松身心。
我们将再次深入你的意识深处。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Hm? How did you come
here? You're not qualified
for this ceremony yet. Come,I will bring you back to Morocc...
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
嗯？你是怎么来到这里的？
你还没有资格参加这个仪式。
来，我带你回莫洛克...

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Do you recognize this
place? Right now, we're
inside your mind. The spirits
of warriors that have died
hover here, waiting for you
to call upon their power.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
你认识这个地方吗？
现在，我们在你的意识之中。
那些战死沙场的战士灵魂
悬浮在此，等待你召唤他们的力量。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Right now, there are only
a few of them here, but if
you continue to train, you
will be able to call upon
more spirits as a Soul Linker.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
目前这里只有少数几个灵魂，
但如果你继续修炼，
作为悟灵士，你将能够召唤更多的灵魂。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
We can only remain in
your mind for 3 minutes.
I suggest that you speak
to the spirits while you
have the opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
我们只能在你的意识中停留3分钟。
建议你在有机会时与灵魂们对话。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Listen to what
spirits are tending to say.
There is a reason why
they cannot move on
to the next world.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
听听灵魂们想要说什么。
他们无法前往下一个世界，
是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
I believe that you are
now ready to become
a Soul Linker. However,
you may continue to
speak with the spirits
if that is what you wish.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
我相信你现在已经准备好
成为悟灵士了。不过，
如果你愿意，也可以继续
与灵魂们对话。

scripts.text: Converse more with the spirits
scripts.translation: 继续与灵魂对话

scripts.text: Become a Soul Linker
scripts.translation: 成为悟灵士

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Alright. Try to hurry
since we can remain in
your mind for a limited
time. Although, we can
go back inside your mind
if you talk to me later...
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
好的。请抓紧时间，
因为我们在你意识中的停留时间是有限的。
不过，如果你之后再来找我，
我们可以再次进入你的意识...

scripts.text:
[Maia]
You are on a riding pet,
so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
你正骑着宠物，
所以无法转职。
请卸下坐骑后再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Then let us begin the
ceremony. These items will
be used to endow you with
the ability to borrow the power
of the fallen warriors and lend
it to your friends in battle.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
那么，让我们开始仪式吧。
这些物品将用于赋予你
借用阵亡战士力量的能力，
并在战斗中将其借给你的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
This Witherless Rose will
wither away instead of you...
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
这朵永恒玫瑰将代替你枯萎...

scripts.text:
[Maia]
This Witherless Rose will
wither away instead of you...
This Immortal Heart will cease
to pump blood, instead of yours.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
这朵永恒玫瑰将代替你枯萎...
这颗不死心脏将代替你的心脏停止跳动。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
This Witherless Rose will
wither away instead of you...
This Immortal Heart will cease
to pump blood, instead of yours. This Diamond will turn to dust,
in place of your mortal body.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
这朵永恒玫瑰将代替你枯萎...
这颗不死心脏将代替你的心脏停止跳动。这颗钻石将代替你脆弱的肉体化为尘埃。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
The dead who wish
to continue fighting...
Will fight for you! Use your
powers as a Soul Linker
wisely and for just purposes.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
那些渴望继续战斗的亡者...
将为你而战！请明智地
使用你作为悟灵士的力量，
并将其用于正义的目的。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou still have unused skill points. Please use all remaining skill points and try again!^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你还有未使用的技能点。请使用完所有剩余技能点后再试一次！^000000

scripts.text:
[Maia]
I wish the best of luck
in your new life. Surround
yourself with allies, and the
spirits will be able to protect
you and help you fight in your battles. Farewell for now, friend.
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
祝你在新的生活中好运。
让盟友围绕在你身边，
灵魂们就能保护你，
并在战斗中助你一臂之力。
暂时别了，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Maia]
Hmm...?
The time for you
to be here has not
arrived. Let's go
back to Morocc...
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
嗯...？
你来到这里的时候
还没有到。让我们
回到莫洛克吧...

scripts.text:
[Maia]
The time has come for
you to venture out into the
wide world! More Soul Linkers
will definitely be needed in the ongoing battle against evil...
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
是时候让你踏入
广阔的世界了！在对抗邪恶的持续战斗中，
肯定还需要更多的悟灵士...

scripts.text:
[Maia]
That's strange...
You're not supposed to
be here. Let me guide
you back to Morocc...
scripts.translation:
[玛雅]
这很奇怪...
你不应该在这里。
让我指引你
回到莫洛克吧...

scripts.text:
[Monk Spirit]
Who am I...?
I think... I think
it would be best if
you spoke to Maya first...
Who and what I am requires
a complicated explanation...
scripts.translation:
[武僧之魂]
我是谁...？
我想...我想
最好你先和玛雅谈谈...
关于我是谁，又是什么，
需要复杂的解释...

scripts.text:
[Monk Spirit]
In life, my peers did
their best to assure me
that I accomplish all that
I could as a Monk. Still...
Still I would never be fully
satisfied with my skills.
scripts.translation:
[武僧之魂]
生前，我的同伴们
尽力确保我
作为一名武僧
能发挥所有潜能。然而...
然而，我对自己的技艺
始终无法完全满意。

scripts.text:
[Monk Spirit]
In death, I had many regrets,
never having the chance to pass
my skills down to future Monks.
Lending my power to others 
is the only chance that I can
possibly have to do this.
scripts.translation:
[武僧之魂]
死后，我留下了许多遗憾，
因为从未有机会
将我的技艺传授给未来的武僧。
将我的力量借予他人，
是我唯一可能
做到这一点的机会。

scripts.text:
[Monk Spirit]
I beg of you...
I need you to help
me fully realize the
true potential of the
Monks of today.
scripts.translation:
[武僧之魂]
我恳求你...
我需要你的帮助，
让我能完全实现
当今武僧们的
真正潜力。

scripts.text:
[Monk Spirit]
...
scripts.translation:
[武僧之魂]
...

scripts.text:
[Sage Spirit]
Speak to Maia.
I'm afraid I may
confuse you if Maia
doesn't first explain
your present situation...
scripts.translation:
[贤者之魂]
和玛雅谈谈。
恐怕如果玛雅没有先解释
你目前的情况，
我可能会让你感到困惑...

scripts.text:
[Sage Spirit]
My pursuit of knowledge
granted me incredible power:
in life, I could have destroyed
anything I wanted. Few Sages
could even reach my level...
scripts.translation:
[贤者之魂]
我对知识的追求
赋予了我惊人的力量：
生前，我可以摧毁
任何我想要的东西。很少有贤者
能达到我的水平...

scripts.text:
[Sage Spirit]
I died, but I was never able
to pass on to the next world.
I still want to use my abilities.I want to use my knowledge
to build what pleases me,
and to destroy as I please.
scripts.translation:
[贤者之魂]
我死了，但从未能
进入下一个世界。
我仍然想使用我的能力。我想运用我的知识
去建造我所喜悦的，
并随心所欲地摧毁。

scripts.text:
[Sage Spirit]
It is enough if I can
lend my power to a Sage
that is worthy of receiving
it. But to do that, I shall
require your help. I beg you,
let me become your spirit ally.
scripts.translation:
[贤者之魂]
只要我能将我的力量
借给一位配得上它的贤者
就足够了。但要做到这一点，
我需要你的帮助。我恳求你，
让我成为你的灵魂盟友。

scripts.text:
[Sage Spirit]
I believe that you
are the only one who
has a chance of bringing
rest to my troubled soul...
scripts.translation:
[贤者之魂]
我相信，
只有你
才有机会让
我受困扰的灵魂
得到安息...

scripts.text:
[Sage Spirit]
...
scripts.translation:
[贤者之魂]
...

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Spirit]
Oh! I really want to
speak to you, but what
I have to say won't make
much sense unless you
talk to Maia first. But yes,
I really need your help.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士之魂]
哦！我真的很想
和你谈谈，但除非
你先和玛雅说话，
否则我说的话
可能没什么意义。不过是的，
我真的需要你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Spirit]
Without exagerrating, I was
the fastest Alchemist in my
time. In fact, I may even be
the fastest Alchemist ever.
But then I grew arrogant, and
killed myself in an accident.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士之魂]
毫不夸张地说，我是
我那个时代最快的炼金术士。
事实上，我甚至可能是
有史以来最快的炼金术士。
但我变得傲慢，
并在一次事故中杀死了自己。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Spirit]
But death would not stifle
my skill. In fact, I've even
improved my skill since I've
passed away. I cannot go
on to the next world until I've
passed on my techniques...
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士之魂]
但死亡无法扼杀
我的技艺。事实上，自从我
去世后，我的技艺
甚至有所提升。在我
将我的技巧传授出去之前，
我无法进入下一个世界...

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Spirit]
I'm powerless as a spirit,
but with your help, I can
influence the Alchemists of
today and help them refine
their skills. I beseech you,
please give me this chance...
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士之魂]
作为灵魂，我无能为力，
但在你的帮助下，我可以
影响当今的炼金术士，
帮助他们磨练技艺。我恳求你，
请给我这个机会...

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Spirit]
...
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士之魂]
...
